counterfactual_text: The dry dandelion head becomes depleted before the gust reaches it, and the detached seeds begin drifting afterward.
positive_text: The gust reaches the dry dandelion, seeds detach progressively from the head, drift away, and leave the same seed head visibly depleted.
semantic_text: A gust blows across a dry dandelion, detaching seeds that drift away while the seed head becomes depleted. Required visible entities: one dry dandelion; full attached seed head; visible stem. At the beginning: dandelion seed head: full, dry, intact, and densely covered with attached seeds; seeds: attached to the same central head. Required state changes: seed attachment: attached to detached; seed positions: head to drifting away; seed-head fullness: full to depleted. These event variables are allowed to change: seed attachment state; seed positions; seed-head fullness. Preserve throughout: static side-view camera; dandelion stem and central-head identity; simple natural background; one dry dandelion seed head; the same seeds and stem; the same outdoor scene.
